# Activation Evidence

Decision question: why did workspace activation fall from 42% to 35% in July?

Activation means creating a workspace, inviting one teammate, and completing one shared task within 7 days. The July tracking release stopped sending `task_completed` for Android 4.8. Android represents 31% of eligible signups. Web activation remained 43%; Android reported 14%. No causal product conclusion has been established.

The next action must distinguish instrumentation loss from real behavior before recommending a product change.
